trap.label: wish + would
trap.wrong: I wish you would be here.
trap.why: Em português “queria que você estivesse aqui” usa subjuntivo. O aluno traduz com would. Em inglês, o desejo sobre o presente usa wish + past (were).

opts: I insist that he is present.
I insist that he be present.

fix.wrong: I wish she was here now.
fix.right: I wish she were here now.

fix.wrong: I wish I would have stayed.
He behaves as if he was the boss.
fix.right: He behaves as if he were the boss.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com wish: “I regret that you left.” (I wish…)
Reescreva com wish: “I am sorry you are away.” (I wish…)
Reescreva com as if: “He acts, but he is not the boss.” (as if he were)
rewrite.answer: He acts as if he were the boss.
